criteria.seen: Each rebuild lobe has a small white highlight dot, as in the clip. [votes: yes/yes/yes]

criteria.seen: Rebuild shows both open and folded narrow wing silhouettes, and they differ between 0.65s and 1s. [votes: yes/yes/yes]
